source_publication_binding.scope: The source Core runtime ConnectionId and public Connect ConnectionId are distinct namespaces. Exported direction is Core-facing: receive means browser-to-Core publication and send means Core-to-browser sink. A source requires Core receive or both plus source_ready true; sink_ready is not required for a source-only replacement. The independently validated public send interval remains client-facing and unchanged. Public connection generation and Core stream generation are separately typed and never assumed equal. Missing, duplicate, ambiguous, foreign-session, changed-stream/transport/generation, private phase and old-target mappings fail. No direct database input, inferred stream-only owner, new authority or history regrade is permitted.
